request.what: Fund Tx3 by TxPipe as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols, including developer and agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,684,050 ADA total, consisting of 1,635,000 ADA for the Open API Layer for Cardano Protocols and a 49,050 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The proposal says Tx3 will provide a standard open-source interface to Cardano protocols through documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposer claims there is currently no common interface mechanism across the Cardano ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and increasing integration costs.
The proposer claims AI agents will increase on-chain activity but require shared, auditable interfaces because hallucinated transactions can irreversibly move assets on-chain.
The document states TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry.
The proposal says the funded work will onboard 12 additional protocols, at 3 per quarter, with full developer and agent coverage.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
The proposal says TxPipe has received 30 Catalyst-funded proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

The document describes milestone-based disbursement controls, Intersect administration, external oversight entities, treasury smart contract addresses, permission thresholds, audit references, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The anchor document requests 1,684,050 ADA for TxPipe’s Tx3 open API layer, framed as 12 months of protocol onboarding and agent/developer infrastructure, with Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, milestone controls, oversight entities, and several external references for voting, audits, and fund tracking.
